name: Fleet tender
text: A Fleet supply tender on the emergency band, reactor scrammed, a midshipman reading regulations into the mic. The Fleet doesn't ask civilians for help. This one is asking.

choices.label: Lend a hand
choices.result: The reactor's back on your spares, and the midshipman logs you a friend of the Fleet. Pirates took her other stores pod: the Fleet would like it home.

choices.label: Raid the stores pod
choices.result: Their stores pod is right there, and they can't move to stop you. The midshipman takes your registration down, very slowly.

choices.label: Keep flying
choices.result: The midshipman is still reading regulations as the band fades.
